company: West Pico Healthcare and Wellness Center
title: Regional Director of Plant Operations - Rockport SoCal/Central
text:
*At Rockport we understand that quality care starts with safe, efficient, and well-maintained environments. Behind every great facility is a great operations leader—and we’re looking for a* ***Regional Director of Plant Operations******- SoCal/Central Cal*** *who is ready to take charge and make an impact across multiple long-term care communities.*

*If you have hands-on nursing home maintenance experience and know what it takes to keep a healthcare environment compliant, comfortable, and safe, this is your opportunity to lead with purpose and join a team that feels like family!*

***We believe in taking care of our team the way we care for our residents, wholeheartedly!***

* ***Competitive Pay:*** *Your leadership deserves to be rewarded.*
* ***Comprehensive Health Benefits:*** *Health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family.*
* ***401(k)*** *Plan for your future.*
* ***Paid Time Off & Sick Leave:*** *Recharge, recover, and take care of what matters.*

***Your Role as Regional Director of Plant Operations:***

* *Oversee plant operations and physical maintenance across multiple nursing home and long-term care facilities.*
* *Lead and support on-site Maintenance Directors and teams to ensure full regulatory compliance and operational excellence.*
* *Coordinate all maintenance services and activities with nursing, administration, and other departments.*
* *Direct and oversee a comprehensive preventive maintenance program and ensure each facility maintains a complete and updated Life Safety Binder****.***
* *Develop and maintain written policies, procedures, manuals, job descriptions, work logs, and operational reports.*
* *Monitor building systems including* ***boilers, HVAC, compressors, generators, sprinkler systems****, and other* ***mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems****.*
* *Diagnose, evaluate, and resolve complex facility issues while developing strategic plans for improvements and compliance.*
* *Ensure all facilities meet or exceed local, state, and federal building codes and* ***Life Safety requirements****.*
* *Read and interpret* ***blueprints*** *to plan, manage, and oversee repairs, renovations, and capital improvements.*

***Who we’re looking for:***

* *Must have experience in a nursing home maintenance position*
* *Thorough knowledge of Life Safety regulations and building codes*
* *Hands-on experience with mechanical systems including boilers, HVAC, generators, plumbing, and electrical systems*
* *Ability to read and interpret blueprints and building schematics*
* *Strong leadership skills to diagnose, strategize, and implement facility-wide plans*
* *Skilled in organizing and directing all maintenance programs and staff*
* *Ability to collaborate effectively with other departments and external vendor*
* *Excellent documentation and reporting habits*

Pay: $110,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
